description: This file defines classes and methods related to stock and product management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including product stock levels, locations, and categories.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: Extends product.product with stock and location related methods and fields.

classes.name: product_template
classes.description: Extends product.template with procurement and production location properties.

classes.name: product_category
classes.description: Extends product.category with stock journal and account properties.

methods.name: view_header_get
methods.description: Returns a header string for product views, customized based on location context.

methods.name: get_product_available
methods.description: Calculates available quantities of products based on stock moves, locations, and date filters.

methods.name: _product_available
methods.description: Wrapper method to get various stock quantity metrics for products.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Customizes the product view fields based on location usage.
